title: Kiln Eval, Dataset Synthesis, and Judgment API
description: Complete field-level wire contract for eval suites and jobs, uploaded datasets, deterministic suite synthesis, and the pairwise-judgment flywheel. Open input objects explicitly preserve serde's accepted-and-ignored unknown-field behavior; emitted objects are closed.

AggregateMetrics.description: Complete aggregate metrics for one suite/adapter run.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: raw kind counts sum to k
representative_completion_index is a member of completion_indices
AggregatedExampleOutcome.description: One independent example statistic reduced from its complete raw completion group.

AnyJson.description: Any JSON value carried without field-level interpretation.

AppendJudgmentBody.description: Append one exact A/B preference row.

AppendJudgmentResponse.description: Assigned row ID flattened with the updated judgment manifest.

ArgsScoring.description: Tool-argument scoring policy, including recursive per-key scorers.

note.const: running job will exit at the next example boundary

CancelEvalJobResponse.description: Queued cancellation, cooperative running cancellation, or terminal-record deletion result.

CodeStyle.description: Code comparison policy. Variant-specific defaulted fields may be omitted on input.

CompileJudgmentBody.description: Compile judgment rows to a swap-augmented SFT dataset with a holdout.

CompileJudgmentResponse.description: Compiled SFT dataset and exact train/validation boundary.

DatasetManifest.description: Persisted dataset identity and structural summary.

DatasetStats.description: Bounded structural statistics computed from an uploaded dataset.

DatasetUploadFormat.description: Accepted multipart dataset format including request aliases.

DatasetUploadMultipart.description: Multipart dataset upload. Unknown parts are drained and ignored.

DecimalU64.description: An exact unsigned 64-bit value serialized as a base-10 string for JavaScript safety.

DeleteDatasetResponse.description: Confirmation that a dataset was deleted.

DeleteJudgmentResponse.description: Confirmation that a judgment dataset was deleted.

DeleteSuiteResponse.description: Confirmation that a suite was deleted.

EvalAggregation.description: Explicit reduction from k raw completions to one independent example statistic.

EvalChatMessage.description: Canonical chat message. Non-string input content is normalized by the runtime's compatibility deserializer.

EvalCompareSpec.description: Run one registered suite against one to eight ordered adapters. Empty adapter names select the base model.

EvalExample.description: One prompt/target pair with optional scoring and generation overrides.

EvalGenerationParams.description: Eval decode parameters. Omitted thinking budgets inherit; explicit null is unlimited; finite values include zero.

EvalJobInfo.description: Tracked eval-job list record; runtime-only Instants and cancellation handles are never serialized.

EvalJobListResponse.description: All retained eval jobs in descending submission order.

EvalProgress.description: Live progress for the active adapter run.

EvalResourceName.description: A non-blank suite, dataset, or judgment name without path separators or '..'.

EvalResult.description: Top-level retained result for a single- or multi-adapter eval job.

EvalRunRequest.description: Submit exactly one registered or inline suite for evaluation.

EvalRunResponse.description: Immutable admission receipt for a queued eval job.

EvalSubmissionKind.description: Admission path that created an eval job.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: tool entries have a non-empty function.name or name
schema version 1 permits only single aggregation and n=1
EvalSuite.description: A validated evaluation suite. Defaulted fields may be omitted on input and are materialized when serialized.

EvalSuiteSummary.description: List-view projection of a registered suite.

ExampleOutcome.description: One scored completion with optional raw reasoning, latency, seed, and thinking-budget evidence.

JudgmentManifest.description: Persisted pairwise-judgment dataset identity and compile split.

PassRateConfidenceInterval.description: Wilson confidence interval for a pass rate.

PostEvalGate.description: Post-training promotion thresholds retained on an eval job.

PromoteJudgmentBody.description: Queue held-out validation for a trained judge adapter.

RenderJudgmentPromptResponse.description: Exact pairwise prompt used by both judge training and inference.

RerunBody.description: Select outcomes and adapter identity for a failure-focused re-run.

Scorer.description: Complete built-in scorer union. Unknown fields are accepted and ignored within each input variant.

ScorerBreakdown.description: Aggregate metrics for one scorer kind.

ScorerChoice.description: Synthesis scorer policy. Fixed scorers use a nested scorer field so both tagged unions remain unambiguous.

SuiteResult.description: Complete result for one suite and adapter, retaining both independent example reductions and raw completions.

SynthesisPreview.description: Non-persisted synthesis preview including the completion reduction that would be persisted.

SynthesisPreviewBody.description: Preview a synthesized suite without persisting it.

SynthesisStats.description: Complete synthesis filtering and deterministic seed statistics. The u64 seed is emitted as an exact decimal string.

SynthesisStrategy.description: How a conversation is decomposed into eval examples.

SynthesizeBody.description: Persist a synthesized suite and optionally queue it against adapters.

SynthesizeDatasetResponse.description: Persisted suite summary plus any auto-queued eval job IDs.

ToolCallWeights.description: Relative tool-call name, structure, and content weights.

UnitInterval.description: A score or rate in the closed interval [0, 1].

CancelEvalJobResponse.note: running job will exit at the next example boundary

RenderJudgmentPromptResponse.prompt: Compare the following two assistant replies...
